text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Following the Satsuki Sho, Ines<n>Fujin's increased
awareness of the<n>competition—and theirs of
her—leaves<n>her even more eager to win.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her determination lights a fire in me,<n>and I promise
to lead her to victory as<n>the fan favorite at the
Japanese<n>Derby—a race that all Umamusume<n>dream
of entering.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And when Ines Fujin hears how<n>much confidence I
have in her, her<n>desire to win grows stronger still.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She wants to thank me—for letting her<n>keep
working, for letting her aim for<n>the Derby... and for
helping her realize<n>her own desires.
